moral.zh: 太阳让地面的水蒸发；湿润空气上升冷却后，水蒸气凝结成云滴，在很冷的云里也可能形成冰晶。它们不断长大并在重力作用下落，水滴直接成为雨，冰晶也可能融化成雨。
moral.en: The Sun evaporates water from Earth's surface. As moist air rises and cools, water vapor condenses into cloud droplets; ice crystals can form in very cold clouds too. As they grow, gravity pulls them down: droplets fall as rain, and ice crystals may melt into raindrops.

pages.zh: “湿润的空气升到高处，会慢慢冷下来。水蒸气在空气中的微小颗粒周围凝结成许多小水滴；在很冷的云里也可能形成小冰晶，云就形成了。”
pages.en: “As moist air rises, it gradually cools. Water vapor condenses into tiny droplets around small particles in the air; in very cold clouds, ice crystals can form too. Together they make a cloud.”

pages.en: “Inside a cloud, tiny droplets can bump together and join into larger drops, while small ice crystals can grow too. Gravity acts on them all along; once they grow large enough, they begin to fall.”

pages.en: “Large drops fall as rain, and some ice crystals melt into raindrops as they pass through warmer air. Rainwater enters soil, streams, rivers, and seas, and sunlight begins the journey again.”

pages.en: The Sun came out the next day. Xiaoshu found only a damp ring where yesterday's puddle had been. “A lot of that water evaporated back into the air, ready for another journey!”
